investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Kescrest Insurance (insurance); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus (zones eastus-1/eastus-2/eastus-3); network range 10.203.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster kescre-prod-eastus (AKS); Database tier: self-managed mysql primary/replica on virtual machines with provider block storage, replica in another zone; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
